# Write: Zeisel mouse brain

Create your report starter from the main project folder:

```bash
Rscript scripts/R/create_report.R zeisel
```

Open `reports/zeisel-report.qmd` and replace the bracketed instructions with your own checked results. Follow [Write the report](../../02-write-the-report.qmd) for what to include.

When the report is ready:

```bash
cd reports
quarto render zeisel-report.qmd
cd ..
```

Read `reports/zeisel-report.html` and confirm the figures display. The whole `reports/` folder is ignored by Git; the helper never overwrites an existing report. If you created a report before figures moved into `figures/`, update its image links to `../results/zeisel/figures/qc.png` and `../results/zeisel/figures/pca.png`.
